summary.name: Alternative Internet project list
summary.one_liner: A long alphabetical directory of networks and technologies aimed at decentralisation, such as mesh networks, peer-to-peer tools, federated social software and decentralised storage.
summary.what_it_does: This page is an alphabetical list of project names (about 250) described as new networks and technology aiming at decentralisation in some form. It includes examples across mesh and wireless networking (such as Freifunk, Commotion Wireless, Project Byzantium), anonymity and overlay networks (Tor, I2P, Freenet, GNUnet), peer-to-peer and decentralised storage (IPFS, Storj, Syncthing, Tahoe-LAFS), and federated social and messaging software (Matrix, Diaspora*, Friendica, GNU social, Briar). The page gives only names, with no descriptions, links or details on each project beyond the list itself.
notable: Covers a broad range of decentralisation projects in one list
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under External Links
Includes mesh networking, anonymity networks, p2p storage and federated social software
caveats: Page is only a bare list of names with no descriptions or status information
Some listed projects may be discontinued; the page does not say which are active
